Can you draw my nerdy warrior lady, please?

Her name is Mahke Etstop. Usually, Mahke has lavender hair with black highlights, an indigo shawl around her shoulders, rectangular glasses (magenta or black), fingerless purple gloves, and stylish black armor. She has slightly tan skin in an attempt at making herself look more confident in her appearance. She carries around a fancy sword from time to time.

If it's all possible, can you draw her with her pet Pokemon fusion Rocky? Rocky is a cute Aegislash/Emolga fusion who wields Aegislash as a cool sword and shield. 

Mahke Etstop References: https://www.dropbox.com/s/wxqfr6g17ig6uzj/Warrior%20Lady%20Outfit.png?dl=0

Hello, Iwanuma!
Thank you so much for reaching out! I’d love to commission an artwork of Kanna Yanagi for cooking-themed stream.

Kanna enjoys watching cooking shows, so I’d like to request an artwork of her dressed as Gordon Ramsay, with the phrase "IT'S RAW, YOU DONKEY!" on the artwork. If possible, I’d appreciate two versions: one with the writing and one without. Additionally, a PNG version with the character separate from the background would be greatly appreciated, as Kanna might use this for video thumbnails or on her social media.

If this theme isn’t something you’d like to work on, please feel free to cancel the request—I’d be happy to send another idea instead.

Thank you for considering my request!

Hello! Thank you for your appeal! I like the way you draw, so I think the idea I came up with for my character Clara would look great in your style.

[Clara] https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1-2pGSuE4DmTV1PTv4Uznu4xEcC1Bj4OF
Clara is a 16-year-old girl, 170 cm tall. Clara is calm and melancholic, thoughtful, looks to the future, looks back at the past. Clara has experienced a lot of psychological trauma in the past

I want the composition of the work to be like this:
She is sitting on a chair at a table in front of a window in a cozy room in a house on the second floor. Draw the furnishings and things in the room at your discretion. Thoughtfully looks out the window away from the center of the metropolis, which looks modern and futuristic for the not-so-distant future (similar to the game "Detroit: Become Human" (link https://imgur.com/a/23cDb9X)).
Since she's sitting at home, draw her in her pajama set, at your discretion!

She is sitting at a table with some basic stationery and a closed music box (similar to this one (you can design it yourself) https://imgur.com/a/bMwq9XV).
She is holding an amulet necklace (similar to this one (you can design it yourself) https://imgur.com/a/gu0apKS).
Beginning of autumn. Day, cloudy. (link https://imgur.com/a/BMkobss).

Please provide me with PSD, with separation of layers, background, character, foreground elements. I want to use this art for a music video, for example there was a parallax effect.

Please draw horizontally with a resolution of 4032 x 2268 if you can. I want to be able to make a parallax effect for a 4K (3840 x 2160) video.
I would like to use it for social networks, YouTube videos and as a cover for a music track.
Please approve my request only if you give me permission to do so!

Thank you very much for considering my request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1-2pGSuE4DmTV1PTv4Uznu4xEcC1Bj4OF

Hello. I just received your appeal on Skeb. I am quite interested to see if you could draw ShinraBanshoumon to the best of your ability.

ShinraBanshoumon is a blonde-haired kitsune gijinka OC with multiple ponytails, which indicate the usual fox tails a normal kitsune would have. These ponytails have white tips just like the Renamon evolution line from Digimon. She wears a purple vest, a black qipao with golden draconic markings, and golden armor inscribed with yin-yang symbols. She has a fang sticking out of her mouth at all times, showing that she's quite immature. She carries around a golden shakujo with a spear tip and a kitsune ornament, with the rings representing the kitsune's nine tails. 

If it's possible, I would like to see ShinraBanshoumon cast a powerful magic spell to show off her might. For this spell, I would like to her create a mighty meteor storm to defeat an unseen opponent.

https://www.dropbox.com/s/s8jq7ipptgwormx/ShinraBanshoumon%20Collage%20Skeb.png?dl=0

(Ashla's eyes slightly glow/shine while using her abilities).
Please give Ashla a dark stary background (- perhaps with some snow covered ground).

Thank-you so very much! 💕

Hello! I appreciate you reaching out with an appeal. Thank you for your interest in Luma. She's the middle child of a trio of catgirl idols. The three idols are themed around the three times of day, with Luma being themed around the evening/twilight. She wants other people to see her as mature, so she tries to act older than she is. She attempts to act confident and self-assured, which sometimes makes her come across as smug and condescending. However, secretly all she wants is praise and affection, and she's rather fragile emotionally.

I would love if you could design a new outfit for Luma to wear. You can pick any type of outfit you'd like, whether it be an idol outfit, a school uniform, a swimsuit, pajamas, casual wear, etc. You can place her in a setting that matches her outfit. I've attached some references of Luma to help establish her fashion sense. She loves wearing frilly and elaborate outfits that make her look impressive, but she gets self-conscious easily if she wears anything that shows too much skin.

Note that her ears and tail are real, and she has no human ears. I hope you have fun with the idea.

https://imgur.com/a/5jeHiyN
